# 2026-07-15 — Epic Phase 1 Stabilization Review

- **[Epic Phase 1](../projects/epic-golive-phase-1.md) went live 2026-06-28 and is now in
  stabilization.** **This supersedes the "on track / pre-go-live" status from 2026-06-12** —
  go-live is done; the project is live.
- Command center still active; ticket volume declining; **demobilization targeted ~2026-08-01**.
- ED throughput dipped during go-live (expected) and is recovering;
  [David Coleman](../people/david-coleman.md) reports the ED workflows are settling.
- Next: kick off [Epic Optimization — Phase 2](../projects/epic-optimization-phase-2.md),
  including the bed-management module, once the command center demobilizes.
